title: Why Joanna Supported Jesus Financially in Secret
paragraphs: Why Joanna Supported Jesus Financially in Secret
That is exactly why her story matters.
She is mentioned only a few times in Scripture, hidden quietly between the names of louder disciples, stronger personalities, fishermen, zealots, and public miracle moments.
And if you have ever loved God silently while carrying pain privately… this story may expose parts of your soul you have hidden from everyone.
Because Joanna was not just another woman following Jesus.
And somehow… she still chose Christ.
That decision could have cost her everything.
Luke records something most people read too quickly.

“And also some women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary, called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out, and Joanna, the wife of Chuza, Herod’s household manager, and Susanna, and many others, who provided for them out of their means.”
The Greek phrase used here is:
“They were serving them out of what belonged to them.”
Jesus and the disciples were being supported by Joanna and these women.
But the deeper shock is who Joanna was married to.
“Joanna, wife of Chuza, manager/steward of Herod.”
The word “ἐπιτρόπου” (epitropou) means administrator, financial manager, steward, trusted overseer.
Chuza was not a random servant.
He handled the affairs of Herod Antipas.
The same Herod Antipas who mocked Jesus.
The same Herod connected to the murder of John the Baptist.
The same corrupt political household soaked in paranoia, compromise, lust, manipulation, and fear.
And inside that darkness… was Joanna.
Surrounded by people pretending righteousness while serving power.
And then she hears about Jesus.
Because money can decorate pain without healing it.
Status can silence loneliness without curing it.
Luxury can distract the soul while the spirit slowly dies.
Many people today are living exactly like Joanna before Christ.
The Gospel reaches people religion ignores.
And Jesus was never intimidated by powerful households.
One of the most overlooked details is this:
Luke says these women had been healed.
Joanna’s healing is not specified, but the wording groups her among women transformed deeply by Christ.
And healed people become dangerous to darkness.
Because once Jesus rescues your soul, money stops being your master.
You start using resources for eternity instead of identity.
This is why Joanna supported Jesus.
Not because she was emotionally pressured.
This may explain why her support was likely discreet.
But likely hidden from political eyes.
Because supporting a rabbi gaining influence while connected to Herod’s administration could become catastrophic.
Joanna hearing reports inside Herod’s world.
Then secretly helping fund the ministry of the Messiah they feared.
Some scholars believe Joanna may have had access to inside political knowledge through Chuza’s position.
While Scripture does not explicitly state every detail, the contextual implications are powerful.
And eventually she chose which King truly mattered.
This is where many readers feel exposed.
Because some people love Jesus privately but fear losing worldly approval publicly.
Some people attend church but still belong emotionally to Herod’s palace.
Still terrified of what people think.
You can live near power and still be starving spiritually.
But you can also surrender everything and finally become alive.
The Hebrew understanding behind stewardship also deepens this.
In Hebrew thought, wealth was never meant to become an idol.
The word often connected to stewardship concepts is:
“שָׁלִיט” (shalit) or stewardship principles tied to entrusted authority.
Biblically, everything belonged ultimately to God.
“The earth is the Lord’s and the fullness thereof.”
Joanna understood something many modern believers forget.
She leveraged earthly wealth to support eternal truth.
That is why heaven remembers her name while history barely remembers Herod’s servants.
And then comes one of the most breathtaking moments.
“Now it was Mary Magdalene and Joanna and Mary the mother of James and the other women with them who told these things to the apostles.”
Still near Jesus even after crucifixion trauma.
Do you understand how powerful that is?
Many followed Jesus when miracles multiplied.
But Joanna stayed through public humiliation.
Some people only follow God while life feels blessed.
This is also deeply connected to the Greek word for ministry and service:
To serve, minister, attend to, care for.
This is where we later derive concepts related to deacons and ministry service.
Joanna’s financial support was not secondary spirituality.
Some people think only preachers matter.
But heaven sees every hidden sacrifice.
Every quiet act that advances the Gospel.
Joanna reminds believers that unseen obedience still shakes eternity.
And maybe that is why this story hurts so deeply.
Because many people secretly know God has been calling them out of compromise.
There are people reading this right now who feel spiritually exhausted because they keep feeding two kingdoms.
You cannot fully belong to Herod’s palace and Christ’s Kingdom simultaneously.
Eventually one will expose the other.
And maybe that is why this article found you.
But because God is confronting hidden loyalties.
Joanna likely hid generosity because the environment around her was hostile to truth.
Yet Jesus still received her faith.
That should give hope to every believer trapped in difficult environments.
And no sacrifice for Christ is ever wasted.
Maybe you have supported others while battling private pain yourself.
Joanna’s story proves heaven remembers names the world overlooks.
And the greatest tragedy is not losing status.
The greatest tragedy is standing near Jesus your whole life while never truly surrendering.
Herod had proximity to truth and still hardened his heart.
Joanna had proximity to corruption and still chose Christ.
This hit harder than you expected.
And if this article reminded you of someone trapped between worldly pressure and spiritual hunger, share this with them.
One day heaven will reveal how many souls were touched by sacrifices nobody on earth applauded.
Bakit Palihim na Sinuportahan ni Joanna si Jesus Gamit ang Kanyang Kayamanan
Karamihan sa mga tao… hindi napapansin si Joanna.
At baka iyon mismo ang dahilan kung bakit napakalalim ng kanyang kuwento.
Kaunting beses lang siyang nabanggit sa Biblia.
Parang isang tahimik na pangalan na mabilis lampasan ng mga tao habang nagbabasa.
At kung minsan ka nang nasaktan nang tahimik…
Kung minsan ka nang naglingkod sa Diyos habang walang nakakaalam ng laban mo…
Maaaring tamaan ka ng kuwentong ito nang mas malalim kaysa inaasahan mo.
Dahil si Joanna ay hindi basta simpleng babae lamang na sumusunod kay Cristo.
May koneksyon siya sa palasyo ni Herodes.
At sa kabila ng lahat ng iyon… pinili pa rin niya si Jesus.
Maaaring ikasira iyon ng kanyang buhay.
Sa Lucas 8:1–3, may isang detalyeng madalas minamadali ng mga tao.
“Kasama rin niya ang ilang kababaihan na pinagaling mula sa masasamang espiritu at mga sakit… si Joanna na asawa ni Chuza, na katiwala ni Herodes…”
Ang salitang “ἐπιτρόπου” (epitropou) ay nangangahulugang tagapangasiwa, administrador, pinagkakatiwalaang katiwala.
Ibig sabihin… ang asawa ni Joanna ay hindi ordinaryong utusan.
Si Chuza ay malapit sa sambahayan ni Herodes Antipas.
Ang parehong Herodes na sangkot sa pagpatay kay Juan Bautista.
Ang parehong Herodes na minamaliit si Jesus.
Habang ang karamihan ay takot lumapit kay Cristo…
May isang babaeng nasa loob mismo ng sistema ng kapangyarihan na lihim na sumusuporta sa ministeryo ni Jesus.
At hindi lang emosyonal na suporta iyon.
Sa Lucas 8:3, ginamit ang Greek phrase na:
“Sila ay naglilingkod mula sa kanilang sariling mga ari-arian.”
Ginagamit nila ang kanilang sariling kayamanan upang suportahan si Jesus at ang Kanyang mga alagad.
At dito nagsisimulang tumama ang kuwento.
Dahil maraming tao ngayon ang katulad ni Joanna noon.
Ang kayamanan kayang takpan ang sakit… pero hindi nito kayang pagalingin ang kaluluwa.
At marahil iyon ang nakita ni Joanna kay Jesus.
At may nangyari sa puso niya.
Sinasabi ng Biblia na ang mga babaeng ito ay “pinagaling.”
Hindi man ipinaliwanag nang detalyado ang sugat ni Joanna… malinaw na may binago si Jesus sa kanya.
At kapag tunay kang hinipo ni Cristo… nagbabago ang tingin mo sa pera.
Ginagamit mo na ito para sa Kaharian ng Diyos.
Ito ang hindi maintindihan ng maraming tao.
Akala nila ang ministeryo ay para lamang sa mga nangangaral.
Pero maging ang tahimik na pagsuporta ay banal sa mata ng Diyos.
Ang salitang Griyego na “διακονέω” (diakoneō) ay nangangahulugang maglingkod, magministeryo, mag-alaga.
Ang suporta ni Joanna ay ministeryo.
At isipin mo ang tensyon sa buhay niya.
Nasa paligid siya ng kapangyarihan ni Herodes.
Marahil nakakarinig siya ng mga usapan laban kay Jesus.
Dahil ang pagsuporta kay Cristo habang konektado sa sambahayan ni Herodes ay maaaring magdulot ng panganib.
Kaya maraming iskolar ang naniniwalang malamang na discreet o tahimik ang kanyang pagtulong.
Hindi dahil ikinahihiya niya si Jesus.
Kundi dahil mapanganib ang paligid niya.
At dito maraming tao ang natatamaan.
Dahil maraming believers ngayon ang lihim na nagmamahal kay Jesus pero natatakot mawalan ng approval ng mundo.
Pero si Joanna… pinili pa rin si Cristo.
Sa Lucas 24:10, pagkatapos ng pagkabuhay na muli ni Jesus, nandun pa rin si Joanna.
Nanatili siyang tapat kahit pagkatapos ng krus.
Maraming tao sumusunod kay Jesus kapag maganda ang buhay.
Pero kapag dumating ang kahihiyan, sakit, at paghihintay… umaalis sila.
At marahil iyon ang dahilan kung bakit napakalakas ng kanyang kuwento.
Dahil pinapatunayan nito na ang tunay na pananampalataya ay hindi nakabase sa comfort.
May mga taong nagbabasa nito ngayon na pagod na pagod na.
Pagod nang mamuhay sa dalawang mundo.
Pagod nang mukhang okay habang wasak sa loob.
At baka ginagamit ng Diyos ang kuwento ni Joanna para tawagin kang bumalik nang buo kay Cristo.
Dahil hindi mo kayang pagsabayin habambuhay ang palasyo ni Herodes at ang Kaharian ng Diyos.
Darating ang araw na kailangan mong pumili kung sino talaga ang Hari ng buhay mo.
At marahil… iyon ang dahilan kung bakit nabasa mo ito ngayon.
Kundi paalala ng Diyos na nakikita Niya kahit ang tahimik mong pananampalataya.
Nakikita Niya ang mga luha mong walang nakakaalam.
Nakikita Niya ang mga sakripisyong walang pumapalakpak.
At walang katapatan kay Cristo ang nasasayang.
Mas tumama ito kaysa inaasahan mo.
Darating ang araw na ihahayag ng langit kung gaano karaming buhay ang nabago dahil sa mga sakripisyong tahimik lang ginawa.
